source_notes: FloatingVesselName is BLANK in GEM for this FSRU; the deployed vessel was the FSRU 'Cape Ann' (built 2010, ~145,130 cbm), owned/operated by Hoegh LNG (now Hoegh Evi). TotalEnergies' own project page (telsf.totalenergies.com, url_verifier PASS on tokens 'Cape Ann'/'Hoegh') names the vessel and states 'The owner of the FSRU Cape Ann is HOEGH LNG'. This is a pure data fill (blank -> value), not a value change. IMPORTANT CONTEXT (see qa status_timeline): the Cape Ann was DEMOBILIZED — TotalEnergies announced demobilization 2025-11-25 and the vessel departed Le Havre by ~2026-01-22 after the Rouen Administrative Court (2025-10-16) ordered the installation decree revoked. The vessel name remains correct for the 2023-2025/26 deployment; a researcher applying the demob status change may also choose to record the departure on the unit timeline. GEM's existing VesselOperator='Hoegh Evi' is consistent (current Hoegh LNG rebrand). VesselOwner='TotalEnergies' in GEM reflects terminal/charter ownership, not vessel hull ownership — left unchanged (consistent with GEM's FSRU convention of recording the terminal sponsor as VesselOwner here).
